categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two business segments: technology services and intelligent equipment. Technology services include energy storage system technical services and testing and commissioning services. Intelligent equipment encompasses intelligent monitoring devices, intelligent power distribution equipment, robots, and drones. These services and products support the power generation, transmission, distribution, and user-side operations within the electric power system.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include energy storage system integration and safety protection, high-precision power electronics modeling and grid connection performance evaluation, energy management and optimization control, intelligent secondary equipment testing, and intelligent monitoring technologies. The company also develops proprietary operating systems (InOS) for intelligent power distribution devices and advanced AI-based image recognition for power equipment inspection. Production methods emphasize customized software development, hardware design, prototyping, and outsourced batch manufacturing for intelligent devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are power grid enterprises, including its controlling shareholder China Southern Power Grid and other regional power companies. It serves the electric power industry across generation, transmission, distribution, and user segments, including large-scale power plants, renewable energy projects, and industrial users. The company also engages in markets related to new energy storage, smart grid construction, and intelligent operation and maintenance.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in Guangdong Province and the broader Southern China region, including the five provinces under China Southern Power Grid's jurisdiction. The company has expanded its market presence to other provinces and Southeast Asia, with subsidiaries in Guizhou and Guangxi provinces. It also participates in national-level projects and collaborates with various regional power grid companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power supply chain. It provides technical services and intelligent equipment that support power generation units, transmission and distribution networks, and end-user power management. It integrates and supplies energy storage systems, testing and commissioning services, and smart grid devices, positioning itself as a technology and service provider within the power system value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on high-quality development driven by innovation in new energy storage, AI, intelligent power distribution, and smart grid technologies. The company emphasizes R&D in energy storage system integration, digital and intelligent testing, AI-enabled monitoring, and robotics for power system operation. It actively participates in national and provincial innovation projects, standards development, and aims to lead in new energy system solutions and digital transformation of power grids.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of intelligent equipment and provision of technical services. The company offers customized integrated solutions combining technology services and smart devices, with pricing based on project scope, technology advantages, and market competition. Sales channels include direct sales, online platforms, and bidding processes, primarily serving power grid enterprises and related customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the Chinese power technology and intelligent equipment sector, especially within the Southern China power grid ecosystem. It competes with other power technology service providers and equipment manufacturers in the new energy storage, smart grid, and power system testing markets. Its strong backing by China Southern Power Grid and extensive R&D capabilities provide competitive advantages in technology innovation and market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.01 billion, an 18.77% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 365 million, up 29.79%. The company maintains a solid growth trajectory supported by expanding market demand and increased R&D investment, which accounted for 7.39% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 4.71 billion, reflecting steady scale expansion and operational stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing comprehensive, integrated solutions combining advanced technology services and intelligent equipment to ensure safe, efficient, and clean power system operation. Its proprietary technologies in energy storage integration, AI-enabled monitoring, and intelligent power distribution devices differentiate it by enhancing grid flexibility, reliability, and digital transformation. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive industry certifications, and close collaboration with major power grid operators underpin its value proposition.
